items.headline: 5-unit condo building permitted on Florence Avenue
items.summary: A permit was issued for a new 5-plex condo development at 2820 Florence Avenue, valued at roughly $1.38 million. Construction has not yet begun, but the project is now cleared to build.

items.headline: Eight ADU permits issued across San José in one week
items.summary: Eight separate accessory dwelling unit permits were issued between Sept. 23-28, several involving garage conversions, ranging from about $54,500 to $185,000 in value. The volume reflects how common ADU additions have become as a way for homeowners to add housing on existing lots.

items.headline: Council weighs potential legal case against fire truck makers
items.summary: The City Council met in closed session to discuss a potential case involving Golden State Fire Apparatus, Pierce Manufacturing, Oshkosh, REV Group, Rosenbauer America, and the Fire Apparatus Manufacturers' Association. No outcome was announced.

items.headline: Council discussed appointing a new City Attorney
items.summary: The closed session agenda included a public employee appointment item for the position of City Attorney.

items.headline: Council weighs 408-unit housing project on El Camino Real
items.summary: Santa Clara City Council held a public hearing on annexing and rezoning land at 451-475 El Camino Real to allow 408 new residential units, backed by a full Environmental Impact Report under CEQA.

items.headline: City in talks with school district over Cubberley site
items.summary: The Parks and Recreation Commission held a closed-session conference on negotiating purchase, exchange, or lease terms for the Cubberley Community Center site at 4000 Middlefield Road with the Palo Alto Unified School District.
